title: AI Agent基础设施竞争白热化：云厂商竞相构建统一推理层与工具链，推动企业级应用深度渗透
core_insight: AI Agent技术正从模型竞争转向基础设施和工具链的标准化突破，Cloudflare、AWS、Google Cloud等云厂商竞相推出统一推理平台、多云连接和边缘主权AI解决方案，标志着AI原生云服务进入新阶段

dimension_texts.technology: Cloudflare推出AI Agent统一推理平台，构建支持14+模型提供商的推理层，并发布Artifacts Git兼容存储和AI Search搜索原语；AWS推出ECS Managed Daemons提升容器编排运维效率；Google Cloud在Vertex AI平台推出Claude Opus 4.7多区域端点，体现云原生AI基础设施的成熟度提升 AWS发布S3 Files功能使S3桶可作为高性能文件系统访问，Azure智能分层存储正式可用优化对象存储成本，Cloudflare推出Agent Lee智能交互界面和Browser Run浏览器渲染能力 Cloudflare's AI Platform: an inference layer designed for agents Artifacts: versioned storage that speaks Git Launching S3 Files, making S3 buckets accessible as file systems Multi-region endpoints are available for Claude on Vertex AI Optimize object storage costs automatically with smart tier—now generally available Introducing Agent Lee - a new interface to the Cloudflare stack Announcing managed daemon support for Amazon ECS Managed Instances Browser Run: give your agents a browser
dimension_texts.infrastructure: AWS Interconnect服务正式可用提供跨云私有连接能力；微软与Armada合作推出Azure Local on Galleon模块化数据中心推进边缘主权AI布局；Google Cloud多区域AI端点部署提升全球服务能力；微软主权云平台获Forrester领导者评价 Cloudflare构建定制技术栈支持超大语言模型高性能运行；火山引擎强调极致性价比的云服务理念；今日无重大芯片/GPU供应更新 AWS Interconnect is now generally available, with a new option to simplify last-mile connectivity Building sovereign AI at the edge: Microsoft and Armada collaborate to deliver Azure Local on Galleon modular datacenters Microsoft named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™ for Sovereign Cloud Platforms Building the foundation for running extra-large language models Register domains wherever you build: Cloudflare Registrar API now in beta
dimension_texts.application: Salesforce深入医疗科技领域推出Agentic Field Execution解决方案；微软宣布核能AI合作项目将AI应用于核能行业；Google Cloud重点布局媒体娱乐行业Agentic生态；火山引擎ArkClaw与飞书集成拓展企业协作场景 AWS推出Sustainability Console整合碳排放报告功能；企业AI应用案例丰富包括BMW使用SLM、MLB的Scout Insights AI等；火山引擎推出完整AI开发教程降低企业应用门槛 The Future of MedTech Field Execution is Agentic AI for nuclear energy: Powering an intelligent, resilient future Building the agentic future: A spotlight on Google Cloud’s media & entertainment partner ecosystem Announcing the AWS Sustainability console: Programmatic access, configurable CSV reports, and Scope 1–3 reporting in one place Cool stuff Google Cloud customers built, April edition: BMW big on SLMs, MLB’s Scout Insights AI, personalized resort experiences 【龙虾部署】ArkClaw x 飞书，唤醒你的龙虾助理
